mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, persona_id AS personaId, user_blacklist AS userBlacklist, allowed_member_task_categories AS allowedMemberTaskCategories, allowed_autonomous_categories AS allowedAutonomousCategories, disabled_tools AS disabledTools, tool_param_overrides AS toolParamOverrides, disabled_skills AS disabledSkills, group_rules AS groupRules, proactive_params AS proactiveParams, transcript_retain_policy AS transcriptRetainPolicy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM group_config WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_config (platform, bot_id, group_id, user_blacklist, allowed_member_task_categories, allowed_autonomous_categories, disabled_tools, transcript_retain_policy) VALUES (#{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, '[]', '[]', '[]', '[]', 'keep') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_id = group_id
mapper.update: UPDATE group_config SET persona_id = #{personaId}, user_blacklist = #{userBlacklist}, allowed_member_task_categories = #{allowedMemberTaskCategories}, allowed_autonomous_categories = #{allowedAutonomousCategories}, disabled_tools = #{disabledTools}, tool_param_overrides = #{toolParamOverrides}, disabled_skills = #{disabledSkills}, group_rules = #{groupRules}, proactive_params = #{proactiveParams}, transcript_retain_policy = #{transcriptRetainPolicy} WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
